item.title: Build muscle now — You’ll thank me later
item.description: Weightlifting is more than just an internet obsession, and it shouldn't be limited to just men — especially since women are the most susceptible to experiencing the effects of muscle loss earlier. Choose whatever method of weight training you prefer, but if you want to build lasting muscle and gain some extra skills along the way, consider some free weight training.

item.title: Men’s lacrosse starts slow in 16-11 loss to Yale
item.description: For a team that came in with all the momentum — winning its last two games in dominant fashion — Boston University men’s lacrosse showed up flat against Ivy League foe Yale University, falling 16-11 on Saturday.

item.title: Men’s basketball offense falters down the stretch in 70-67 loss to Lehigh
item.description: Midway through the second half, Boston University seemed poised to extend its win streak to six after hitting 13 of its first 15 shots in the half and opening up a 13-point lead over Lehigh University, its largest of the game.

item.title: Women’s basketball’s defensive struggles lead to a tough loss against Lehigh
item.description: The Boston University women’s basketball team fell short versus Lehigh University, losing 76-61 as a result of a standout Mountain Hawk offensive performance.

item.title: ‘We are sorely disappointed’: COM StuGov rescinds dean’s town hall invitation, requests communication from Dean’s Office to student body about Epstein
item.description: The College of Communication’s Student Government rescinded COM Dean Mariette DiChristina’s invitation to this year’s town hall and released a statement on Instagram Sunday night requesting more clarity from DiChristina about her correspondence with Jeffrey Epstein after he pleaded guilty to soliciting a minor for prostitution in 2008.

item.title: For the next stage in my life, I want to be like André Leon Talley
item.description: While he didn’t come from immense wealth, he still pursued higher education, traveled abroad and eventually became a notable figure in the worlds of fashion and media. Also, despite his accomplishments, instead of being an icy person, he was exuberant and warm. In celebration of Black History Month, and in remembrance of Talley, I’d like to take time and reflect back on his early life and his remarkable professional journey.
